cards.ex: There's a steep learning curve with this new software, but it's worth it.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi dastur bilan o'rganish qiyin, lekin bunga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani o'rganish juda qiyin va ko'p vaqt talab etadigan jarayon.

cards.ex: We have several new projects in the pipeline for next year.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi yil uchun bir nechta yangi loyihalarimiz jarayonda.
cards.uzDef: Hali amalga oshirilmagan, lekin rejalashtirilgan yoki ishlab chiqilayotgan.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the cost of the repairs?
cards.exUz: Ta'mirlash narxi uchun taxminiy raqamni ayta olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Aniq bo'lmagan, lekin taxminiy bo'lgan son yoki miqdor.

cards.ex: Let's aim to have this report finished by close of play tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga ish kunining oxirigacha bu hisobotni tugatishga harakat qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Ish kunining tugashi yoki biror tadbirning yakuni.

cards.ex: Before the audit, make sure you get your ducks in a row.
cards.exUz: Tekshirishdan oldin, hamma narsani tartibga soling.
cards.term: get your ducks in a row
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani to'g'ri va tayyor holatga keltirish.

cards.ex: Please keep me in the loop about any changes to the schedule.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, jadvalga kiritilgan har qanday o'zgarishlar haqida meni xabardor qiling.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishiga sodir bo'layotgan voqealar haqida xabar berib turish.

cards.ex: He always does everything by the book; you can rely on him.
cards.exUz: U har doim hamma narsani qoidaga ko'ra qiladi, unga ishonishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani qonuniy va rasmiy qoidalarga muvofiq bajarish.

cards.ex: There's a bit of a learning curve when you start using this software.
cards.exUz: Ushbu dasturni ishlatishni boshlaganingizda, ozgina o'rganish jarayoni bor.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani o'rganishga ketadigan vaqt va qiyinchilik darajasi.

cards.ex: This new technology could be a real game changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy o'zgarish yasovchi bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tubdan o'zgartiradigan yangilik yoki hodisa.

cards.ex: The deal fell through, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv amalga oshmadi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani qaytadan boshlashga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's hard to get a foot in the door in the film industry.
cards.exUz: Kino sanoatida imkoniyat qo'lga kiritish qiyin.
cards.term: get a foot in the door
cards.uzDef: Biror tashkilotga kirish yoki imkoniyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I'm working from home.
cards.exUz: Bugun o'zimni biroz kasalmand his qilyapman, shuning uchun uyda ishlayapman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, biroz kasal bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to ensure a level playing field for all competitors.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha raqobatchilar uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun bir xil imkoniyatlar yaratilgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: We're short-staffed this week due to the holidays.
cards.exUz: Bayramlar tufayli bu hafta xodimlar yetishmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Yetarli xodimlar bo'lmagan holat.

cards.ex: I heard about the layoffs through water cooler talk.
cards.exUz: Men bo'shatishlar haqida gap sotish orqali eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Ish joyida odamlar o'rtasidagi norasmiy suhbat.

cards.ex: The nurses are at the coalface, dealing with the patients every day.
cards.exUz: Hamshiralar har kuni bemorlar bilan ishlaydigan eng og'ir ishda.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri mijozlar bilan ishlaydigan yoki eng qiyin vaziyatda bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Let's engage in some blue-sky thinking to come up with new product ideas.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulot g'oyalarini o'ylab topish uchun keling, ijodiy fikrlash bilan shug'ullanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Cheklanmagan holda, juda ijodiy va yangi g'oyalar haqida o'ylash.

cards.ex: Sometimes I just want to escape the daily grind.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan men kundalik mashaqqatdan qochishni xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik zerikarli va monoton ish.

cards.ex: Fast-forward ten years, and the company was a global leader.
cards.exUz: O'n yilni tezlashtiring va kompaniya global liderga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealarni tezlashtirish yoki kelajakka ko'chirish.

cards.ex: He's just going through the motions at work these days.
cards.exUz: U hozirgi kunlarda ishda shunchaki beparvo bajarmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday qiziqish yoki ishtiyoqsiz ishni bajarish.

cards.ex: I have a lot on my plate right now, so I can't take on any new projects.
cards.exUz: Menda hozir ko'p ishim bor, shuning uchun men yangi loyihalarni ololmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p vazifalar va majburiyatlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: It takes a while to learn the ropes when you start a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ish boshlaganingizda ishni o'rganish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishda yoki faoliyatda zarur bo'lgan narsalarni o'rganish.

cards.ex: You can trust him; he's always on the up-and-up.
cards.exUz: Unga ishonishingiz mumkin, u har doim halol.
cards.uzDef: Halol va qonuniy yo'l bilan amalga oshirilgan.

cards.ex: Replacing Sarah as CEO will be a tough act to follow; she was exceptional.
cards.exUz: Sarohni bosh direktor lavozimiga almashtirish qiyin vazifa bo'ladi; u juda zo'r edi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi odam juda yaxshi ishlaganidan keyin, uning natijalarini takrorlash juda qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: To improve your chances of getting hired, focus on developing marketable skills.
cards.exUz: Ishga joylashish imkoniyatini oshirish uchun bozor talab qiladigan qobiliyatlarni rivojlantirishga e'tibor qarating.
cards.uzDef: Ish beruvchilar tomonidan qadrlanadigan, ish topishga yordam beradigan qobiliyatlar.

cards.ex: She's the go-to person for any technical issues in the office.
cards.exUz: U ofisdagi har qanday texnik muammolar bo'yicha yordam so'rash mumkin bo'lgan odam.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatlarda yordam so'rash mumkin bo'lgan, tajribali va ishonchli shaxs.

cards.ex: He found success by focusing on a niche market for handcrafted furniture.
cards.exUz: U qo'lda yasalgan mebellar uchun tor bozorga e'tibor qaratish orqali muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, aniq maqsadli guruhga mo'ljallangan bozor segmenti.

cards.ex: After only six months, he jumped ship to a competitor offering a higher salary.
cards.exUz: Olti oydan keyin u yuqori maosh taklif qilgan raqobatchi kompaniyaga ketib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir ishdan boshqa ishga tezda o'tib ketish, odatda yaxshiroq imkoniyatlar uchun.

cards.ex: The per diem for the conference covers meals and incidentals.
cards.exUz: Konferensiya uchun kunlik to'lov ovqat va boshqa xarajatlarni qoplaydi.
cards.uzDef: Safar xarajatlarini qoplash uchun beriladigan kunlik to'lov.

cards.ex: The job offers excellent fringe benefits, including a company car.
cards.exUz: Ish yaxshi qo'shimcha imtiyozlarni taklif qiladi, shu jumladan kompaniya mashinasi.
cards.uzDef: Maoshdan tashqari, ish beruvchi tomonidan taqdim etiladigan qo'shimcha imtiyozlar (masalan, tibbiy sug'urta).
